gloss: to grant; to bestow; to teach

definitions.gloss: to grant, to bestow, to confer
definitions.explanation: To give something of value (an award, title, blessing) from a position of authority or higher status.
To pass on knowledge or skills, often from master to student.

examples.japanese: {王|おう}が{騎士|きし}に{称号|しょうごう}を{授|さず}けた。
examples.english: The king bestowed a title on the knight.

examples.japanese: {神|かみ}が{人間|にんげん}に{命|いのち}を{授|さず}けた。
{大学|だいがく}が{長年|ながねん}の{功績|こうせき}をたたえて{名誉|めいよ}{博士号|はかせごう}を{授|さず}けた。
examples.english: The university conferred an honorary doctorate in recognition of years of achievement.

examples.japanese: {師匠|ししょう}が{弟子|でし}に{技|わざ}を{授|さず}けた。
examples.english: The master taught the technique to the apprentice.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{生|い}きる{知恵|ちえ}を{授|さず}けてくれた。
examples.english: My father imparted the wisdom of life to me.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{何十年|なんじゅうねん}にもわたって{学生|がくせい}たちに{医学|いがく}の{知識|ちしき}を{授|さず}けてきた。
examples.english: The professor has been imparting medical knowledge to students for decades.

notes:
PAIR: {授|さず}ける（{他動詞|たどうし}）= to bestow ↔ {授|さず}かる（{自動詞|じどうし}）= to be granted, to receive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賞|しょう}を{授|さず}ける: to bestow an award
- {称号|しょうごう}を{授|さず}ける: to confer a title
- {知恵|ちえ}を{授|さず}ける: to impart wisdom
- {技|わざ}を{授|さず}ける: to teach a technique
- {命|いのち}を{授|さず}ける: to grant life

USAGE: A formal, elevated word implying a top-down relationship (superior to subordinate, teacher to student, deity to human). More dignified than あげる or {教|おし}える.
